description: Na₄Al₃Si₃CNO₁₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Ccc2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three AlO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.50 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to one N and three O atoms to form distorted NaNO₃ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaNO₃ tetrahedra, corners with three AlO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra. The Na-N bond length is 2.48 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.39 Å. There are two inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.75 Å) and three longer (1.76 Å) Al-O bond lengths. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. All Al-O bond lengths are 1.76 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four AlO₄ tetrahedra. All Si-O bond lengths are 1.64 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra. All Si-O bond lengths are 1.64 Å. C is bonded in a linear geometry to one N and one O atom. The C-N bond length is 1.20 Å. The C-O bond length is 1.23 Å. N is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom.
